summary: The ansible.platform collection adds platform-wide RBAC modules (organization, team, user, role definitions, role assignments) for declaring RBAC as code, and AAP collections now share the AAP_ environment variable prefix (for example aap_hostname) instead of COMPONENT_.
questions: Which collection manages RBAC across AAP 2.6?
What environment variable prefix do AAP collections use in 2.6?
Can I manage role assignments as code in AAP?
Is CONTROLLER_HOST still used in AAP 2.6 collections?

answer_card.title: ansible.platform RBAC and AAP_ variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible.platform` modules: organization, team, user, role definitions, role assignments (team/user); apply RBAC idempotently across services.
- Controller, hub and EDA collections now use the **`AAP_`** prefix instead of component prefixes, for example `aap_hostname`.
